name: save_place
title: Save Place
description: rbx-native's own tool, not one of Studio's (Studio's MCP has no way to save). Saves the place to its file, as File > Save does. Given a path, saves there instead and keeps working on that file from then on, as Save As does: .rbxl writes binary, .rbxlx XML, and a relative path is taken from the place's folder. Answers with the file written.

path.description: Save As: the .rbxl or .rbxlx file to write. Leave out to save over the place's own file.

studio_id.description: Which editor to act on: an id from list_roblox_studios. May be left out while only one editor is open.

name: import_model
title: Import Model
description: rbx-native's own tool, not one of Studio's (Studio's MCP cannot read a model file). Imports a 3D model into the place as Model > Import 3D Model does, uploading it through Open Cloud with the editor's API key, then makes it a ready kit piece: one Model named after the asset, every part anchored, scaled to studs, its pivot on its base centre at `position`, and Source/License/Author attributes for a kit. Give either `path`, a local .glb, .gltf, .obj or .fbx file, or `provider` and `id`, a free CC0 kit model: provider "polyhaven" with a Poly Haven model slug (the end of polyhaven.com/a/<slug>, e.g. ArmChair_01), or provider "local" with a <pack>/<model> id from a pack the user added in Toolbox > Free kits. Scale defaults to the kit's own: metres to studs (1 stud = 28 cm) for Poly Haven and glTF files, 4.5 studs per unit for Kenney's kits (24 for its city kits), 1 for OBJ and FBX. Each call is one upload. Answers like insert_asset, with the new Model's fullPath.

path.description: A local .glb, .gltf, .obj or .fbx file to import.

provider.description: A free kit provider, with `id`: "polyhaven" or "local" (a pack added in the Toolbox).

id.description: The kit model: a Poly Haven slug, or <pack>/<model> for an added pack.

scale.description: Studs per unit of the file, replacing the kit's own scale.

position.description: Where the model's base centre lands, [x, y, z] in studs. The origin when left out.

parentPath.description: Dotted path to insert under, like Workspace.Props. Workspace when left out or not found.

studio_id.description: Which editor to act on: an id from list_roblox_studios. May be left out while only one editor is open.
